hypotheses.justification: The proof uses `hX` only through `heatE_times_U`, which needs it only for `heatE_before`. The patch part, `OutgoingDilation.correction_times_U_zero`, takes only `hXR`. The statement still holds for X ≤ 0 because `Real.log` is even. `OutgoingDilation.U F XR (X, eta) = F.U (X / XR, eta) = F.logU (Real.log (X / XR), eta)`, so U(X, eta) = U(-X, eta) by `neg_div` and `Real.log_neg_eq_log`. Also `heatE F XR (X, eta) = OutgoingDilation.E F XR (X, eta) * HeatTailEdit.multiplier h ν K X`, where K = switchRadius F XR > 0, `multiplier h ν K X = 1 + switch K X * (…)` and `switch K X = OutgoingSchedule.sigma (Real.log (X / K) / (3/10))`. Proof without hX, by cases. (1) |X| ≤ K: by `Real.log_abs`, Real.log (X / K) = Real.log (|X| / K). This is ≤ 0 by `Real.log_nonpos`, since 0 ≤ |X|/K ≤ 1; it also covers X = 0, where log 0 = 0. So `OutgoingSchedule.sigma_zero` (which needs only x ≤ 0) gives switch K X = 0, the multiplier is 1, heatE = OutgoingDilation.E, and both sides agree. (2) X > K: `U_after_switch` (which needs only hXR) gives U = 0, so both sides are 0. (3) X < -K: U(X, eta) = U(-X, eta), and this is 0 by `U_after_switch`, since -X ≥ K; both sides are 0. Finally, E = heatE + patchIncrement, and patchIncrement * U = 0 exactly as in the current proof, without hX.
